# Multipart Type

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:MultipartType`](gmeow-MultipartType.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/MultipartType>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/email`](../../slices/email.md)

The MIME multipart subtype of a [`MultipartBodyPart`](gmeow-MultipartBodyPart.md) — an open value vocabulary (individuals, never subclasses). Standard subtypes are seeded; new subtypes (e.g. form-data) are added as individuals.
